lines.text: Rudolph the red-nosed reindeer had a very shiny nose!
But reindeer have an even wilder superpower in their eyes!
In bright summer, reindeer eyes shine with a sparkling golden color!
But during dark arctic winters, their eyes turn deep, ocean blue!
The constant winter darkness makes their pupils stretch wide open day and night!
This pressure tightens the reflective mirror behind their retinas!
Blue eyes scatter moonlight, letting reindeer spot hidden lichen beneath the snow!
Now you know the real arctic magic behind Santa's reindeer!
